initialize: v.pose_moving = v.pose_moving ?? 0; v.pose_serial = v.pose_serial ?? 0; v.pose_dt = v.pose_dt ?? 1;
v.pose_initialized=0; v.pose_ready=0; v.pose_received=-1; v.pose_seen=0; v.pose_age=0; v.pose_alpha=1; v.pose_duration=0.05; v.pose_frame=0.05;
v.pose_rate=20; v.pose_rt=1; v.pose_rn=20; v.pose_rt2=0.125; v.pose_rn2=2.5; v.pose_dv=0; v.pose_lo=0;
v.pose_px=0; v.pose_py=0; v.pose_pz=0; v.pose_qx=0; v.pose_qy=0; v.pose_qz=0; v.pose_qw=1; v.pitch=0; v.yaw=0; v.roll=0; v.pose_play=0; v.pose_was_moving=0;
pre_animation: v.pose_changed ? { v.pose_gap=v.pose_cn-v.pose_received; v.pose_reset=!v.pose_initialized || v.pose_gap<=0 || v.pose_gap>60; v.pose_near=!v.pose_reset && v.pose_was_moving; v.pose_rt=v.pose_near ? v.pose_rt*0.95+v.pose_age : v.pose_rt; v.pose_rn=v.pose_near ? v.pose_rn*0.95+v.pose_gap : v.pose_rn; v.pose_rt2=v.pose_near ? v.pose_rt2*0.6+v.pose_age : v.pose_rt2; v.pose_rn2=v.pose_near ? v.pose_rn2*0.6+v.pose_gap : v.pose_rn2; v.pose_r1=v.pose_rn/math.max(v.pose_rt,0.001); v.pose_r2=v.pose_rn2/math.max(v.pose_rt2,0.001); v.pose_off=v.pose_r2>v.pose_r1*1.3 ? 1 : (v.pose_r2<v.pose_r1*0.7 ? -1 : 0); v.pose_dv=v.pose_near ? (v.pose_off==0 ? 0 : (v.pose_off==v.pose_lo ? v.pose_dv+1 : 1)) : v.pose_dv; v.pose_lo=v.pose_near ? v.pose_off : v.pose_lo; v.pose_rt=v.pose_dv>=3 ? v.pose_rt2*8 : v.pose_rt; v.pose_rn=v.pose_dv>=3 ? v.pose_rn2*8 : v.pose_rn; v.pose_dv=v.pose_dv>=3 ? 0 : v.pose_dv; v.pose_rate=v.pose_reset ? 20 : math.min(v.pose_rn/math.max(v.pose_rt,0.001),25); v.pose_rt=v.pose_reset ? 1 : v.pose_rt; v.pose_rn=v.pose_reset ? 20 : v.pose_rn; v.pose_rt2=v.pose_reset ? 0.125 : v.pose_rt2; v.pose_rn2=v.pose_reset ? 2.5 : v.pose_rn2; v.pose_interval=math.max(math.max(v.pose_dt,v.pose_near ? v.pose_gap : 0)/v.pose_rate,v.pose_near ? v.pose_age : 0); v.pose_duration=math.max(v.pose_interval,v.pose_duration*(1-v.pose_alpha)+v.pose_interval*v.pose_alpha); v.pose_ax=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_px : v.pose_cx; v.pose_ay=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_py : v.pose_cy; v.pose_az=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_pz : v.pose_cz; v.pose_aqx=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_qx : v.pose_cqx; v.pose_aqy=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_qy : v.pose_cqy; v.pose_aqz=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_qz : v.pose_cqz; v.pose_aqw=v.pose_initialized ? v.pose_qw : v.pose_cqw; v.pose_alpha=v.pose_initialized ? 0 : 1; v.pose_age=0; v.pose_received=v.pose_cn; v.pose_seen=v.pose_serial; v.pose_was_moving=v.pose_moving; };

v.pose_play ? { v.pose_alpha=math.min(1,v.pose_alpha+v.pose_step/v.pose_duration); v.pose_px=v.pose_ax+(v.pose_cx-v.pose_ax)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_py=v.pose_ay+(v.pose_cy-v.pose_ay)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_pz=v.pose_az+(v.pose_cz-v.pose_az)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_dot=v.pose_aqx*v.pose_cqx+v.pose_aqy*v.pose_cqy+v.pose_aqz*v.pose_cqz+v.pose_aqw*v.pose_cqw; v.pose_sign=v.pose_dot<0 ? -1 : 1; v.pose_qx=v.pose_aqx+(v.pose_cqx*v.pose_sign-v.pose_aqx)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_qy=v.pose_aqy+(v.pose_cqy*v.pose_sign-v.pose_aqy)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_qz=v.pose_aqz+(v.pose_cqz*v.pose_sign-v.pose_aqz)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_qw=v.pose_aqw+(v.pose_cqw*v.pose_sign-v.pose_aqw)*v.pose_alpha; v.pose_len=math.max(0.0001,math.sqrt(v.pose_qx*v.pose_qx+v.pose_qy*v.pose_qy+v.pose_qz*v.pose_qz+v.pose_qw*v.pose_qw)); v.pose_qx=v.pose_qx/v.pose_len; v.pose_qy=v.pose_qy/v.pose_len; v.pose_qz=v.pose_qz/v.pose_len; v.pose_qw=v.pose_qw/v.pose_len; v.pose_test=v.pose_qx*v.pose_qy+v.pose_qz*v.pose_qw; v.pose_sx=2*(v.pose_qx*v.pose_qw-v.pose_qy*v.pose_qz); v.pose_cosx=1-2*(v.pose_qx*v.pose_qx+v.pose_qz*v.pose_qz); v.pose_cosz=math.sqrt(v.pose_sx*v.pose_sx+v.pose_cosx*v.pose_cosx); v.pose_pole=v.pose_cosz<0.00001; v.pitch=v.pose_pole ? v.pitch : math.atan2(v.pose_sx,v.pose_cosx); v.yaw=v.pose_test>0 ? 2*math.atan2(v.pose_qx+v.pose_qy,v.pose_qw+v.pose_qz)-v.pitch : v.pitch-2*math.atan2(v.pose_qx-v.pose_qy,v.pose_qw-v.pose_qz); v.roll=math.atan2(2*v.pose_test,v.pose_cosz); };
